worldcombat.skill.tripledive.summary: Three timed leaps, each diving at the target and bursting into water on landing; every landed dive drenches the target, and an already soaked target takes the next dive harder. When all three land on one target, the third is heaviest.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.0: Dive three times into one target, heavier each time
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.1: Open by drenching the target so the later dives take the full bonus
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.use.2: Stack three small hits in a short close-range window
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.description: Each of the three dives deals about %1$s Water contact damage, reaching %2$s blocks with a %3$s block splash radius; the target's Defence, type matchup and crits are settled per dive.

Every landed dive drenches the target and refreshes it to %2$s; against a target that is already drenched, that dive's power rises to %1$s. When all three dives land on one target, the second and third take this bonus automatically.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.plunge.on: Deep Plunge: higher leaps, each dive 20 percent heavier, splash radius x1.2 and drench duration x1.25, but the rhythm is +2 ticks and the cooldown +6 ticks: harder hits on a longer window for the target.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.plunge.off: Quick Hop: faster dives, each 10 percent lighter and a shorter cycle, but smaller splashes and a shorter drench: steadier and denser, lighter per hit.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.timing: Range %1$s blocks; %2$s s preparation, %3$s s recovery, %4$s PP, %5$s s cooldown.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.growth.0: From level %1$s each dive rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.growth.1: From level %1$s each dive rises to %2$s and the drench lasts %3$s.
On: each dive x1.2, splash radius x1.2, drench x1.25, but rhythm +2 ticks and cooldown +6 ticks. Off (Quick Hop): each dive x0.9, normal rhythm and cooldown.
Beyond this distance it closes in instead of leaping. The reach is short, so a large value often still cannot connect.
On: targets already carrying drenched rank higher (every dive takes the soak bonus); off: every target scores the same.
world_combat.move.tripledive.text.full: All three dives land (%1$s dives, %2$s hits)
worldcombat.skill.tripledive.description: Whether a dive lands depends only on where the target is at that moment: it hits while the target is within %1$s blocks of dive reach plus the %2$s block splash radius, and misses once the target is outside; before each leap the user slides up to 0.7 times the dive reach toward the target to pull a fleeing target back into range.
